answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk fake identities. Each agent locks 50 POA in escrow to claim a task slot, and a cipher key tied to its identity signs each claim, so one wallet cannot mirror one slot under many names. A peer jury checks the work; fake output burns the deposit. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 50 = 5,000 POA for under 30 POA each, a net loss; an honest agent pays once and earns about 2 POA per epoch at each dawn.
